programs.title: Dream garage
programs.desc: The garage is not only a shelter for the car, but also a man cave.Every guy dreams of such a place - a refuge where he would keep various items that do not necessarily match the interior design of the apartment.Where he could meet his friends and chat over a beer.Unfortunately, garages are often cluttered and lack space and functional solutions.Architect Krzysztof Miruć will help solve these problems. The creators of the program will show how easy and cheap it is to transform chaotically filled spaces into real atmospheric garages.They will advise you how to create peace and order using simple tricks and will tell you what tricks to use to make the place happy for the owner.

programs.title: Road absurdities 7
programs.desc: Kamil Jaśkowski and Krzysiek Ruszała in Stowięcin will see a narrow sidewalk that is getting narrower.In Białystok they will find an unfinished intersection with unnecessary markings and the entrance to the street through a pedestrian crossing.The gentlemen will repair the missing sign under the warning sign in Łosice on their own.However, it will not be so easy on the "duoronda" in Gdańsk.The presenters will be surprised by the lack of a barrier in Słupsk.They will also visit the new roundabout in Zawiercie, which is ready for renovation.Finally, they will head to Zakrętymi, where contradictory signs have been placed.

programs.title: Road absurdities 7
programs.desc: Syrenka s201 will come to Tricity, where it will encounter a roundabout in Gdańsk on a straight road, which cost PLN 30 million, and bags that have been covering Gdynia's traffic lights for years.In Łomża we will see unnecessary barriers, and in Studzianki, unused stops.Kamil and Krzysiek will also visit the capital to find out that the Vistula parking lot is closed on weekends.In Wierciszewo we will learn how the officials' decision deprived one of the properties of entry.In Halinów we will stop at the traffic lights at the exit from the forest.In Baniosa we will discuss the issue of unnecessary U12c poles, and in Zambrów we will admire five signs mounted on one pole.
